candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — official Slovenian public procurement portal
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory national publication point for all Slovenian contract notices and contract award notices (obvestila o oddaji naročila), operated by the Directorate for Public Procurement (Direktorat za javno naročanje, MJU). This is where ATM purchase/maintenance, POS terminal, cash-in-transit (prevoz in varovanje gotovine), card issuing and core banking tenders by Slovenian public bodies and state-owned entities must appear. Award notices carry contract value, winning bidder and often quantities (number of terminals/ATMs).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword + CPV-filtered search of notices and award notices; scheduled scrape of notice detail pages (Obrazci/?id_obrazec=NNNNNN pattern observed); cross-link to e-JN and OPSI exports rather than deep-crawling the UI.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search for procurement portal + confirmation via Banka Slovenije reference to enarocanje.si as its publication venue
queries_used: portal javnih naročil bankomati vzdrževanje razpis Slovenija
Banka Slovenije javna naročila razpisi objave naročnik bsi.si

candidates.source_name: e-JN — Elektronsko javno naročanje (ejn.gov.si), incl. 'Aktualna javna naročila' listing
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenia's e-procurement transaction system (submission, e-opening, e-catalogues). Its 'Aktualna javna naročila' page lists live tenders with contracting authority, subject, deadlines and opening dates — the earliest signal that a bank/ATM/POS/CIT contract is coming to market, ahead of award publication.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the aktualna_javna_narocila listing (JSF page) or, preferably, the equivalent OPSI dataset export; keyword-filter on domain glossary.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search; snowballed from portal javnih naročil results
queries_used: portal javnih naročil bankomati vzdrževanje razpis Slovenija

candidates.source_name: OPSI — Evidenca javnih naročil (open dataset of Slovenian public procurement records)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable national open-data dump of procurement records from 1 Jan 2013 onward: contracting authority (name, region), procedure (subject, legal basis, procedure type) and bidder (name, country, region). This is the single best bulk-quantitative entry point for building a Slovenian ATM/POS/CIT/core-banking contract dataset without scraping.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CKAN API / direct resource download, then keyword+CPV classification against the sl/en glossary; refresh on dataset update cadence.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search for odprti podatki + javna naročila
queries_used: "javna naročila" statistika portal odprti podatki OPSI naročnik pogodbe evidenca Slovenija

candidates.source_name: OPSI — Aktualna javna naročila v informacijskem sistemu e-JN (dataset resource)
candidates.why_relevant: Structured feed of currently open tenders (authority, title, code, publication timestamp, portal reference number, submission deadline, opening date, status) — the automatable version of the e-JN listing for pipeline monitoring of ATM/POS/CIT lots.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled resource download via CKAN datastore endpoint; diff against previous snapshot to detect new relevant tenders.
candidates.discovered_via_method: OPSI dataset snowballing
queries_used: "javna naročila" statistika portal odprti podatki OPSI naročnik pogodbe evidenca Slovenija

candidates.source_name: OPSI — Pregled objavljenih pogodb po oddaji javnega naročila (published post-award contracts)
candidates.why_relevant: Under the access-to-public-information law, contracting authorities must publish the actual signed contracts following award. This gives contract text — not just the notice — which is where terminal counts, ATM fleet sizes, SLA terms, unit prices and contract duration for ATM maintenance / CIT / POS deals actually live.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download index, filter to relevant authorities/CPV, then fetch contract PDFs for targeted extraction of quantities and values.
candidates.discovered_via_method: OPSI search snowballing
queries_used: "javna naročila" statistika portal odprti podatki OPSI naročnik pogodbe evidenca Slovenija

candidates.source_name: STATIST — OPSI public procurement statistics application
candidates.why_relevant: Analytical front-end over Slovenian procurement data from 2013 onward: largest contracting authorities, largest winning bidders, most frequent procurement subjects. Useful for ranking vendors (incl. security/CIT firms and IT integrators serving banks) and for sizing categories quickly before deep extraction.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/periodic analytical queries; prefer the underlying OPSI datasets for automated pipelines.
candidates.discovered_via_method: OPSI search
queries_used: "javna naročila" statistika portal odprti podatki OPSI naročnik pogodbe evidenca Slovenija

candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU supplement), Slovenia notices
candidates.why_relevant: All above-threshold Slovenian contract and award notices are mirrored to TED in structured eForms/XML with CPV codes, values and awarded-supplier data. TED is the cleanest cross-border comparator: it lets Slovenian ATM/POS/CIT/core-banking awards be benchmarked against neighbouring markets using the same CPV taxonomy.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the documented TED Search API (POST expert queries, no authentication) filtered on country=SVN plus CPV sets for ATM/cash-handling, banking services, security/CIT and core-banking software; fall back to daily/monthly XML bulk packages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en search + snowball into TED developer docs
queries_used: TED tender notice Slovenia ATM cash machines contract award bankomati
TED europa eu API tenders search Slovenia notices open data XML bulk download

candidates.source_name: TED Search API (docs.ted.europa.eu)
candidates.why_relevant: Documented, authentication-free read API for querying TED notices with expert query syntax. The technically correct collection channel for a repeatable Slovenian banking/payments procurement dataset.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Implement a POST-based expert-query client; persist notice IDs and eForms fields; rate-limit politely.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en search on TED API/open data
queries_used: TED europa eu API tenders search Slovenia notices open data XML bulk download

candidates.source_name: TED XML bulk download (daily/monthly packages) + TED FTP archive
candidates.why_relevant: Full historical corpus of EU notices in XML (archive reportedly back to 1993 via FTP with guest credentials). Enables longitudinal reconstruction of Slovenian ATM/POS/CIT contract cycles and incumbent rotation over decades — not obtainable from any vendor-published material.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off historical backfill from monthly packages, then incremental daily packages; parse XML/eForms and index SI notices.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en search, TED help pages
queries_used: TED europa eu API tenders search Slovenia notices open data XML bulk download

candidates.source_name: TED Open Data Service (SPARQL / RDF)
candidates.why_relevant: Semantic access to the whole TED corpus; SPARQL queries can extract custom cross-notice datasets (e.g. all SI awards under banking/ATM CPVs with values and suppliers) far more cheaply than scraping HTML notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: SPARQL queries against the endpoint; cache results locally.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en search, TED data-reuse page
queries_used: TED europa eu API tenders search Slovenia notices open data XML bulk download

candidates.source_name: ERAR (KPK) — public-money transaction application
candidates.why_relevant: Successor to Supervizor, run by the Commission for the Prevention of Corruption (KPK) under Art. 75.a/75.b ZIntPK. Shows actual transactions from public bodies and state/municipality-owned companies to named suppliers, and since the 2025 relaunch also e-invoices of budget users from Sep 2024. This converts awarded contracts into realised spend — revealing what CIT firms, ATM vendors, terminal suppliers and core-banking integrators are actually paid, including under contracts never competitively tendered.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query by supplier tax ID/name for the vendor watchlist (CIT firms, ATM/POS vendors, banks); prefer the OPSI-published dataset resource for bulk pulls over UI scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search for public spending transparency; snowballed from KPK
queries_used: Erar supervizor javna poraba transakcije proračunskih uporabnikov KPK Slovenija

candidates.source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) — decisions database and eRevizija
candidates.why_relevant: Independent review body ruling on the legality of procurement procedures. Its published decisions quote tender specifications, competitor objections, pricing structures and technical requirements in unusual detail — often the only public place where an ATM/POS/CIT specification and the competitive dynamics between bidders are laid out. Review filings are made via the eRevizija portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the odlocitve-dkom decision index (dated slug + case number pattern, e.g. 018-079-2025) and full-text search for glossary terms; extract cited specifications and bidder names.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on revision/appeal procedures
queries_used: Državna revizijska komisija eRevizija zahtevek za revizijo odločitve baza javna naročila

candidates.source_name: MJU Direktorat za javno naročanje — annual statistical reports on awarded public contracts
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory annual statistical report (Statistično poročilo o oddanih javnih naročilih) adopted by government, broken down by procedure, sector and subject; provides denominators for market sizing (e.g. total public procurement value EUR 9.17bn in 2023) and the official category taxonomy against which banking/security/IT lots can be positioned.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the annual PDF/DOCX series from the MJU DJN assets path and the OPSI collection of annual reports; parse tables for category totals.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search for ministry statistical reporting
queries_used: Ministrstvo za javno upravo statistično poročilo o javnih naročilih letno poročilo gov.si javna naročila
local_language_terms_used: statistično poročilo o oddanih javnih naročilih

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije — razpisi / javna naročila (central bank as contracting authority)
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank is itself a contracting authority and procures cash-cycle infrastructure: banknote processing and authentication machines, numismatic production, cash logistics, vault and security services, and IT. Its own notices (and its statement that all procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si) map the state-side cash-handling supply chain. Its Katalog informacij javnega značaja is the formal transparency index.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the razpisi/javna-narocila section and the objave feed; cross-reference to enarocanje.si notice IDs. URL path reported in search results but not independently fetched — treat as unverified.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on central bank procurement
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javna naročila razpisi objave naročnik bsi.si

candidates.source_name: Računsko sodišče RS — audit reports and audit archive
candidates.why_relevant: The Court of Audit routinely examines whether auditees ran lawful procurement and how they manage cash handling and banking/payment arrangements. Audit reports name suppliers, contract values, and irregularities (e.g. contracts concluded without a procurement procedure) — an independent quality check on the procurement record and a pointer to off-portal spend.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full-text search the audit archive for glossary terms; download report PDFs (fileadmin/user_upload/revizija/... pattern) for targeted extraction. The Court also publishes its own javna naročila page.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on audit reports covering procurement and cash operations
queries_used: Računsko sodišče revizijsko poročilo gotovinsko poslovanje bančne storitve javna naročila rs-rs.si

candidates.source_name: javnirazpisi.com — commercial Slovenian/European tender aggregator
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregator indexing Slovenian and EU tenders with e-mail alerting and its own topical taxonomy. Useful as a discovery/pointer layer to find notice titles and contracting authorities that keyword search on the official portal misses, and to surface the local phrasing vendors actually use.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use for manual discovery/lead generation only; do not build the dataset on it — always resolve back to the official enarocanje.si/TED notice. Check ToS before any automated access.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search for procurement portals
queries_used: portal javnih naročil bankomati vzdrževanje razpis Slovenija

candidates.source_name: javni-razpisi.si (EUJN) — tender alerting service
candidates.why_relevant: Second Slovenian aggregator/alerting service covering national and EU notices; cross-checking two aggregators plus the official portal reduces the chance of missing an award notice with idiosyncratic wording (e.g. 'samopostrežne naprave' instead of 'bankomati').
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual periodic keyword sweep; resolve everything back to official sources.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search for procurement portals
queries_used: portal javnih naročil bankomati vzdrževanje razpis Slovenija

candidates.source_name: SPOT / eVEM — licensing register for cash transport and valuables protection (prevoz in varovanje gotovine)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines the regulated activity and licence requirements for cash-in-transit in Slovenia (own or contracted monitoring centre, liability insurance, premises in Slovenia, at least one CIT vehicle). Establishes the universe of legally eligible CIT bidders — the set of companies that can win a Slovenian cash-transport tender — and the compliance criteria those tenders will cite.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read the activity page for conditions; snowball to the licence-holder list published by the competent chamber/ministry to build the CIT bidder universe.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on cash transport tenders; snowballed to licensing
queries_used: javno naročilo prevoz gotovine varovanje denarja razpis Banka Slovenije

candidates.source_name: PISRS — Pravilnik o načinu prevoza in varovanja gotovine ter drugih vrednostnih pošiljk
candidates.why_relevant: The binding rulebook setting methods, minimum conditions and security measures for transferring, transporting and protecting cash. Slovenian CIT and ATM-replenishment tenders reference these categories directly, so it supplies the controlled vocabulary (transport classes, vehicle/escort requirements) needed to parse tender specifications correctly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch consolidated text once; re-check on amendment; use to build the CIT specification glossary.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on cash transport regulation
queries_used: javno naročilo prevoz gotovine varovanje denarja razpis Banka Slovenije

candidates.source_name: ZPJS — Zakon o plačilnih in javnofinančnih storitvah (payment services for budget users / UJP)
candidates.why_relevant: Governs how payment and public-finance services are provided to direct and indirect state budget users and municipalities, and includes provisions on contracting authorities reporting executed payments under procurement contracts. Explains WHY certain bank/payment services for the public sector are routed via UJP rather than tendered on the open market — critical for correctly interpreting the absence of bank-service tenders on the portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read of consolidated text; snowball to UJP (Uprava RS za javna plačila) publications as a follow-up actor.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on public-sector payment services procurement
queries_used: "javno naročilo" banke plačilne storitve "plačilni promet" naročnik občina razpis Slovenija 2025

candidates.source_name: Bankart d.o.o. — Slovenian card/ATM/POS processor (procurement-adjacent actor)
candidates.why_relevant: Bankart processes ATM and POS transactions for member banks, manages the shared ATM network and provides technical care for ATMs. It is the de-facto counterparty/aggregator whose name recurs in Slovenian bank-side technology procurement and whose own supplier tenders (and NLB Group ownership) shape ATM/POS hardware selection. Essential actor-map node for reading award notices correctly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor site sections (pridobiteljstvo, plačilni sistemi in storitve, podporne storitve) and use the company name as a search token across enarocanje.si, TED, ERAR and DKOM decisions.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on ATM/POS processing; snowballed as actor
queries_used: Bankart procesiranje bankomati POS Slovenija javno naročilo razpis

negative_findings.description: Slovenian-language searches for actual ATM award notices ('enarocanje.si obvestilo o oddaji naročila bankomat', 'portal javnih naročil bankomati vzdrževanje razpis') returned portal homepages and commercial bank ATM-locator pages, not individual notices.
negative_findings.result_summary: General web search engines do not index enarocanje.si notice detail pages well; individual notices were not surfaced. This is an indexing limitation, not evidence that such notices do not exist.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must go through the portal's own search/CPV filters, the OPSI bulk datasets and the TED API rather than through general web search, or ATM/POS award notices will be systematically missed.

negative_findings.description: Commercial banks in Slovenia (NLB, OTP, Intesa Sanpaolo, UniCredit, DBS) are not contracting authorities under the public procurement act for their commercial ATM/POS estates.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for POS terminal procurement returned only banks' commercial POS rental offers and terms & conditions, not tenders.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The procurement channel will capture public-sector and state-owned-entity demand (ministries, municipalities, Banka Slovenije, Pošta, utilities) but NOT the bulk of the commercial ATM/POS fleet. Fleet-size inference from tenders must be explicitly scoped to the public segment to avoid over-generalising the market.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm the exact CPV code family for ATMs/cash dispensers from search results; only 66110000 (banking services) and 79710000-4 (security services, used for cash-in-transit) were corroborated.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search on '30123600' returned equipment vendor pages and no authoritative CPV mapping.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A CPV-driven collection filter is the most reliable way to harvest TED/enarocanje notices; the ATM/cash-handling CPV set must be verified against the official CPV nomenclature before the filter is built, or coverage will be incomplete.

negative_findings.description: WebFetch of https://www.enarocanje.si/ returned only the page title with no navigation, search or API detail.
negative_findings.result_summary: Page is very likely live but renders content dynamically or is bot-defended; treated as UNVERIFIED, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection from enarocanje.si may require a headless browser or should be replaced by the OPSI/e-JN structured exports; this must be tested before committing to a scraping design.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a Banka Slovenije tender specifically for cash transport / cash-in-transit services.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced only CIT licensing rules, Eurosystem cash strategy pages and commercial bank cash-handling T&Cs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Do not assume the central bank tenders CIT publicly; the cash logistics chain may run through NLB/Bankart or long-standing framework agreements. Record as an open question rather than a conclusion.

coverage_gaps.description: State-owned / public-interest entities that plausibly tender ATM, POS, cash-handling or core-banking services were not individually investigated: Pošta Slovenije (postal counters and cash), SID banka, SDH (Slovenski državni holding), UJP (Uprava RS za javna plačila), DARS (tolling POS/payment acceptance), Slovenske železnice, and large municipalities.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second pass enumerating these authorities by name against enarocanje.si, TED (buyer name), ERAR and DKOM decisions; each is a distinct contracting-authority node.

coverage_gaps.description: No verified CPV code set for ATM/cash dispensers, card issuing/personalisation, and core banking software.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve the official CPV nomenclature (SIMAP/TED) and pin the exact code ranges for divisions 30 (office/computing machines), 48 (software incl. banking systems), 66 (financial services) and 79 (security services), then encode them as the harvest filter.

coverage_gaps.description: Local-language glossary is solid for cash transport and ATMs but thin for card issuing/personalisation and core banking. Terms such as 'personalizacija plačilnih kartic', 'izdajanje kartic', 'jedrni bančni sistem', 'core banking sistem', 'kartično poslovanje' were used only partially; noisy terms identified: 'bankomati' (dominated by bank ATM-locator pages), 'razpis' (also means scholarship/donation calls), 'javni razpis' (grants, not procurement).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Expand the sl glossary with card-issuing and core-banking vocabulary and re-run portal-internal searches; explicitly separate 'javno naročilo' (procurement) from 'javni razpis' (grant call) in query design.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian national open data starts at 2013 (Evidenca javnih naročil); pre-2013 national coverage was not established, though TED FTP reportedly reaches back to 1993.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use TED bulk XML for the pre-2013 window and document the discontinuity in any longitudinal series.

coverage_gaps.description: Automated access characteristics (robots.txt, rate limits, JS-rendering, ToS) were not tested for enarocanje.si, ejn.gov.si, erar.si or dkom.si.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a technical feasibility probe on each before designing collectors; prefer OPSI/TED structured endpoints wherever they duplicate portal content.

brief: Slovenia has an unusually well-instrumented procurement transparency stack for this cell: the statutory notice portal (enarocanje.si) and its transaction system (e-JN) are mirrored into machine-readable OPSI datasets covering notices, awarded contracts and even published contract texts from 2013 onward, with TED providing the above-threshold, CPV-coded, API-accessible EU layer back to the 1990s. Three high-value secondary layers turn notices into hard intelligence: ERAR (KPK) shows realised payments to named suppliers including e-invoices since Sep 2024, DKOM decisions expose tender specifications and bidder disputes in detail, and the Court of Audit flags off-portal or non-compliant spend. The principal structural limit is that Slovenia's commercial banks are not contracting authorities, so this channel captures public-sector and state-owned demand for ATM, POS, cash-in-transit and core-banking services rather than the whole national fleet — a scoping caveat that must be carried into any sizing estimate. Priority next steps are pinning the exact CPV code set for ATM/card/core-banking categories and enumerating named contracting authorities (Pošta Slovenije, UJP, SID banka, DARS, large municipalities) rather than relying on keyword search, since general web engines do not index individual Slovenian notice pages.
